Sandbox_ItemSpawnBlocker_Enabled_tooltip: Master switch. When off, no items are blocked.
Sandbox_ItemSpawnBlocker_BlockList_toolt: Items to remove from newly generated loot, separated by ';' or ','. Each entry is matched case-insensitively and partially against the internal item ID (e.g. Base.Axe, HuntingKnife, gun, ammo).
Sandbox_ItemSpawnBlocker_FilterContainer: Also remove blocked items from containers filled after world generation (zombie corpses, etc.). Server-side; leave off unless needed.
Sandbox_ItemSpawnBlocker_BlockRecipes_to: Master switch for recipe blocking. When off, no crafting recipes are blocked.
Sandbox_ItemSpawnBlocker_RecipeBlockList: Crafting recipes to remove, separated by ';' or ','. Each entry matches, case-insensitively and partially, against the recipe name, its category, or the result item ID. Examples: Forge (all forging), Blacksmithing, DisassembleFirearms, SheetMetal, Base.Axe.
